steps.run:
./dev bootstrap install --offline
./dev bootstrap install --offline --scope=solana
source scripts/env.sh
./dev bootstrap verify --offline
./dev bootstrap verify --offline --scope=solana
./dev doctor --scope=core

source scripts/env.sh
pnpm rollback:evidence:validate --bundle="$AGTMAI_ROLLBACK_EVIDENCE_DIRECTORY" --expected-sha="$GITHUB_SHA"
scripts/assert-complete-history.sh "$GITHUB_SHA" b7a868f85d89c4bb7a9aeed1d854a5f949306a45 3231e8a918c6079c8b384b5389fef2be9f25d33f
scripts/assert-clean-head.sh "$GITHUB_SHA"

with.name: rollback-diagnostics-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/rollback-proof-${{ github.sha }}/diagnostics.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rollback-proof-${{ github.sha }}/commands
${{ runner.temp }}/rollback-proof-${{ github.sha }}/survivors

prohibitedChanges: do not add a seventh job
do not add a skip flag
do not remove rollback:prove from the candidate root check
do not replace frozen or offline installs with a network fallback
do not use a shallow or partial checkout for the rollback proof
do not run any dependent quality gate before complete history, workspace, tool-cache, Docker and pinned-image preflight succeeds
do not replace the non-pulling preflight with prepare-image or another pull command

proofContract.candidate: actions/checkout must detach the explicit github.sha with fetch-depth 0; GITHUB_SHA must equal the clean HEAD before and after the root check, and the proof independently checks the same identity before materialization
proofContract.history: the checkout must be non-shallow and non-partial, contain no replacement refs or legacy grafts, contain and fully traverse the pinned content baseline b7a868f85d89c4bb7a9aeed1d854a5f949306a45, prove with replacement processing disabled that main-history anchor 3231e8a918c6079c8b384b5389fef2be9f25d33f is an ancestor of GITHUB_SHA, and contain every object reachable from the exact head; depth-one, grafted, replaced or ambiguous-ref evidence is invalid
proofContract.workspace: the source frozen install populates the verified pnpm store; every disposable checkout runs pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline and may not fetch
proofContract.toolchain: the proof copies checksum-verified cached core and Solana archives into each disposable checkout, then runs bootstrap install and verify offline
proofContract.slither: SLITHER_DOCKER_PATH is the explicit absolute Docker CLI; prepare-image may preload but is not verification, so the subsequent rollback --preflight-only command must non-pullingly inspect the reachable daemon and exact linux/amd64 image digest, platform and source revision before the root check; the proof repeats that preflight before any phase=gate command
proofContract.preflightOrdering: complete history, exact head, frozen workspace, every pinned archive/binary, Docker CLI/daemon and exact Slither image validation must finish before any dependent quality gate; any missing class yields zero rollback phase=gate command records
proofContract.evidence: volatile diagnostics remain separate from the strict closed deterministic proof statement; the runner independently validates the schema, exact gate coverage, artifact digests and canonical proof digest before publishing READY last, revalidates the sealed bundle and candidate inventory, uploads a verified proof only on success, and labels failure output as diagnostics rather than proof
proofContract.skips: the required real Solana, Anvil and Slither survivor gates may not skip or degrade to unit-only evidence

workflowTests: keep the workflow at exactly six jobs and do not add needs edges
allow timeout-minutes 120 only for foundation-and-typescript while retaining the existing limits for all other jobs

change the source upload-artifact count from one to three only after the final integrated workflow bytes exist: one existing Slither artifact, one success-only verified rollback proof and one failure-only diagnostics artifact

assert the foundation checkout pins github.sha, fetch-depth 0 and persist-credentials false, then rejects shallow/partial history, replacement refs, legacy grafts, an absent baseline, non-ancestor baseline or an exact-head mismatch before bootstrap

assert the exact rollback temp/evidence environment, pinned Forge/solc paths, explicit Docker path, reachable daemon, Solana-scope bootstrap, Slither preload followed by the concrete non-pulling rollback --preflight-only digest/platform/source-revision verifier before the root check, always complete-history/exact-clean-head assertion after it, independent proof validation before success-only proof upload, and separately named failure diagnostics
assert no surviving workflow command names a package script removed by a rollback
rollbackTransforms: because every operational slice removal strips rollback:test and rollback:prove from package.json, restore the foundation checkout to its pre-proof form, remove the complete-history assertion, proof-only timeout/environment, Solana cache/preload and non-pulling preflight additions, proof validation, verified-proof upload and diagnostic upload in every removed-slice workflow output

for every removal, editWorkflowTest must reverse the matching proof-only foundation assertions: no explicit github.sha/fetch-depth checkout or complete-history step, timeout 120 back to 15, and no rollback environment, Solana-cache, Slither-preload, rollback --preflight-only, proof-validation, proof-upload or rollback-diagnostics expectation
for local-solana and deployment-plan removal, rewrite the workflow-test upload count from three to one because the surviving solidity-security upload remains
for Slither removal, rewrite the workflow-test upload count from three to zero because the removed solidity-security upload and both proof-only foundation uploads are absent
for Slither removal, remove every foundation preload or environment reference to the deleted security:solidity:prepare-image script and Slither toolchain

manifestRehash.instruction: the final integrator regenerated all three exact before/after SHA-256 transitions and manifest fingerprints after the feature and CI bytes were fixed; any later integration must immediately invalidate this status and repeat the regeneration
manifestRehash.evidenceLimit: the regenerated manifests pass exact current-worktree coverage and production apply regressions; no commit was authorized here, so clean exact-head validation, full per-slice gate proof and hosted exact-head CI execution remain pending and are not claimed

recomputeAfterFinalBytes: each manifest ownedPaths list against its final worker-owned root

every reverseEdits beforeSha256 and afterSha256 transition for .github/workflows/ci.yml, architecture/foundation/source-dependencies.yaml, package.json, scripts/tests/workflow.test.mjs, tooling/toolchain.lock.json and each slice-specific root entrypoint or restored stub declared by that manifest
the exact unique two-slice survivingGates complement and shared-path coverage
finalIntegrationManifestRegeneration.acceptance: exact current-worktree coverage and production apply regressions pass after regeneration; the externally created clean candidate must still pass validation, the full exact-head per-slice gate proof and hosted CI, and any later integration must return this status to pending before evidence can be cited
